crossRefs.note: “You shall observe the feast of weeks with the first fruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of harvest at the year’s…
In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening, is Yahweh’s Passover.
The next day after the seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days; and you shall offer a new meal offering to Yahweh.
“Speak to the children of Israel, and say, ‘On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of booths for seven…
Three times in a year all of your males shall appear before Yahweh your God in the place which he chooses: in the feast…

translations.web: “You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.
translations.bsb: Three times a year you are to celebrate a feast to Me.
translations.kjv: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.
translations.asv: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.
